The most important karma measurements for a Voat as a whole might not be SCP and CCP, but rather things like the following

Voat hardware and software points

Voat hosting and packet routing points

Voat design points

Voat coding points

Voat logistical points

Voat release points

Voat operation points

Voat administration points

What you have right now is unworkable complexity and irrelevant data. The who's responsible for Voat and who deserves credit for Voat is information found in a few peoples minds, it hasn't been made concrete and visible to everyone who uses the site, which would be the ideal.

When you spend many number of hours on something, it is human nature to assign a high value to it. But this "labor theory" of value has been completely discredited. The value of what you create is only discovered through the price mechanism. It is determined by how much money people give you for what you've done. Also how much time they spend using it.

The value you've added to the world by being a creator of Voat could be a measurable and tangible thing, if you were willing to document what you have done and scientifically keep track of the relevant details. The old words of significance are no longer especially meaningful or helpful.

Saying you're University Computer Science and Economic students. That live in a city. That city being in Switzerland. And there being some other party in another city. That city being in Sweden. If it gets large enough there will be reporting to various authorities about its operations.

But these reports will be of little use. Due to oligarchies and various kinds of socialisms, there is little practical information that can be gleaned about what is really going on. And who is to be credited for doing what. And which things that Voat offers are valued by how many users and how much value do these users assign to each specific aspect.

If you want something of quality. And something of the highest uncommon denominator. You'll have to think bigger and outside of the usual trails of thought. You'll want to be more open about everything. Treat this project as one big family business. Where all the well intention users and participants are kept abreast of everything. And know what is being done, and who is doing it.

A well-functioning community is one where there is no single goto person that has all the answers. But rather a network of cooperating experts and casual users who all have some part of the answer for the organism as a whole.

Think of how a human body works. All those different types of cells working with each other. Some cells being far more important than others, but every cell having its part to play. And throughout that body, there is all manner of symbiotic and antagonistic organisms that live within that same body.

The body has many processes and protocols, and these are all constantly adjusted and perfected, yet over time, there's discernible patterns you can learn. No cell lives forever, new cells are born, old cells die, but the body abides and grows in wisdom and experience and has a long and productive life, if everything goes as planned.

This is just the beginning of a new economic and computer scientific discipline you might well already be implementing of course. It's just a simple idea for Voat, from a single user of your growing and thriving new community.
